biggest_catch: Total referral payouts capped at $599.99 per member per calendar year (combined referrer/new-member payouts), and incentives are paid no sooner than 90 days after the membership opens.
catches: For each qualifying referral, Premier pays $50 to the new member, $50 to the referrer, and makes a $50 charitable donation.
Total referral payouts capped at $599.99 per member per calendar year (combined referrer/new-member payouts); may be reported to the IRS.

New member must complete ONE path within 90 days of membership opening: (1) checking — qualifying personal checking + digital banking + eStatements + two direct deposits of $250+ each; or (2) loan — approved and funded qualifying loan of $10,000+.
Incentives paid no sooner than 90 days after membership open and requirements met; each recipient must be in good standing at payout.
Referral must be identified at account opening (no retroactive referrals); referrer's name provided at membership opening.
New member: no current/prior Premier membership or ownership within the last 12 months; personal memberships only; 18+.
Cannot be combined with other checking/loan offers; program may be modified/suspended/ended at any time.
